verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own Git Sync stores project data, including collections, scripts and tests, directly in a Git repository, which gives your automations version control. Git version control for collaborative work and AI commit-message suggestions further support versioning. A built-in merge view lets you review and resolve conflicts in the app. However, nothing documents an in-app rollback or revert of automation versions, and the review evidence covers conflict resolution only, not change review or diffs. Missing for 10: documented rollback/revert of automations, a general change-review/diff workflow beyond conflict merging, independent or hands-on corroboration.
